data.name: Quest Filter Mod
data.teaser: A mod for changing quests and a random quest generator with rewards.
data.description:
A mod for sorting standard or modded quests, removing conditions, binding to a merchant, location, and randomizing.

A random generator of standard tasks, across various locations, conditions, and reward settings.

Linear tasks with new tasks unlocking as you complete them.

Removal of temporary and arena quests.

For a full description, read README.md for the basic setup, and RandomQuests/README.md for the random quest setup.

This mod does not save created quests, their order, or filtering. It creates a temporary quest list for each SPT server launch.

Report any bugs, errors, or problems you notice. Happy hunting.
data.custom_ai_disclosure: Creation of methods, classes and code generation - followed by testing for functionality

versions.description:
### Version 1.0.4
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
### Added 
* Skip filtering quests by merchant or by quest type. "SkipQuest" 
	System skip available quests from filter and changes. 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
### Fixed. 
* Random conditions for basic quests. Fixed a bug with conditions for one session. 
	Additional conditions for quests could be reset due to partial completion. 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
### Changed. 
* Point Visit quests. Now you can explicitly specify the conditions for the quest to survive or transit. 
	You can disable the condition to survive in the location for the quest. 

* Kill quests. Weapon sets. 
	Now when you specify a weapon, its assembled version is given. 
	More details **RandomQuests.README**. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Updated the **RandomQuestConfig.json** configuration file

### Version 1.0.3
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Added
* Assassination quests. Added the ability to specify time and weapon to complete the condition. Random time, weapon list.
* Basic quest modifier. Creates the ability to add new random task conditions to the basic quest. Similar to the combo quest system. Read **README**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Corrected.
* Some bugs in filter implementation parameters.
* Temporary quests should not cause errors when disconnected.
* Combo quest generation. Code errors.
* Localization of some parts of the code.
* Locations initialization and binding by name.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Changed.
* Quest Delivery, Lighthouse - added option to issue an item when starting the quest.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
> [!CAUTION]
> The new version contains changes to the configuration. Please update all configuration files.

### Version 1.0.2
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Added. Combo Quest
Generate random combo quests - each quest includes different task types.
Adjust the number of from/to conditions, location binding, and quest type.
* Added. Quest Chain.
All quests, standard and random, will now be in a random chain.
Adjust the random number of initial quests and the chain of completed quests.
After completing a quest, a random number of quests may be awarded.
* Added. Skill Reward.
A skill reward can be added to the player upon completing a random quest.
Adjust the number, hide, randomize, and disable.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fixed. **RemoveFinishConditionTypes** functionality.
Fixed deletion to complete quests.
Updated the list of possible quest end conditions. See **README.md**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Changed. **ExperienceRewardRange** is now separately available in the settings.
Update **RandomQuestConfig.json**
* Changed. Quest generation. Hiding rewards upon quest completion.
The reward parameters now include an **Unknown** field for hiding rewards for quest completion.
The reward the player receives upon completion can be hidden in the quest.

### Version 1.0.1
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* New. Added quest type - Beacon.
This quest is similar to the item stash quest. However, it requires a beacon or jammer to complete.
The item is awarded upon starting the quest.
Configuration via **RandomQuestConfig.json**. Completion timer. Location zones
* New. Raid item transfer quest.
Quests to find and transfer items from a raid. With customizable item quantities and conditions.
Customizable items to find. Available in all locations.
* New. Localization - Separate.
All localizations can be changed or added for convenience.
Only EN and RU are added as standard.
Localization files are located in the **Locales** folder and have the **.json** format.
* New. Quest - Kills - Objectives.
Added an array of objectives to allow for more efficient quest generation in a location. Use goal settings in **RandomQuestConfig.json**.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Update. Quest zones.
New locations for generating quest zones have been added.
**RandomQuestConfig.json** needs to be updated to the latest version.
All quest points have not been fully tested.
* Update. Merchant quest reassignment.
Standard quests can now be assigned to more than one merchant.
An empty value [] will skip reassignment.
Update **Config.json**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Changed. Quest filtering
Filtering of random quests along with standard ones has been removed.
* Changed. Quest - Delivery and Lighthouse.
Removed duplicate positions of possible quest generations.
* Changed. Quest - Visiting a waypoint. Now the conditions for entering a zone and exiting a location will be met in a single session.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Fixed. Standard location filter.
Fixed the code for randomly sorting quests by location.
Slightly changed the location sorting logic. See **README.md**
